Guidance and Python samples for the azure-ai-transcription SDK: key or Entra ID auth, batch and real-time speech-to-text with diarization, retry policy, bounded LRO polling, listing and deleting transcription jobs, and the async client.

Medium only because SKILL.md:20 has `pip install azure-ai-transcription` (official Azure SDK package). Everything else is sample code for the user's application; the key is read from TRANSCRIPTION_KEY via AzureKeyCredential and the skill says never to hardcode credentials. The agent is not told to read, print, or send real secrets.

non-hero-scenarios.md:79-95 deletes every succeeded transcription job in the account when run; users should scope it. The samples use AzureKeyCredential throughout despite recommending DefaultAzureCredential, and users should verify method names (begin_transcription, begin_stream_transcription) against current SDK docs. Audio sent for transcription may contain personal data. No hidden content or external file dependencies.
